svg.title: Enterprise window layout — front, rear and starboard orthographic views
svg.desc: Editable reference reconstruction from six supplied screenshots. Gold marks are lit windows; dark marks are unlit. Dashed outlines need review. Repeated views show the same window IDs.
svg.text: Unique cabin windows; navigation lamps and review apertures excluded.

svg.text: Window states are traced from the supplied images; positions are estimated from perspective views. Hidden sectors remain unresolved.
Every mark has a stable ID and editable 3D position. Registration to the simulation’s curved hull is a separate implementation step.
